text: たくの　むすめは　ほんと　わがままに　そだって…　おともだちも　あまり　おりませんの

structure.jp: ほんと　わがままに　そだって…
structure.en: has really grown up selfish, and...

structure.jp: おともだちも　あまり　おりませんの
structure.en: she doesn't have many friends either

patterns.name: あまり〜ない
patterns.span: あまり　おりません
patterns.explanation: あまり with a 'not' ending means 'not much' or 'not many'. おりません is a humble polite form of いません. あまり　おりません = 'there aren't many'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form leaves the sentence open and leads on to what comes next. そだって = 'grew up, and'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end is a soft, ladylike form of のだ that gives an explaining tone. おりませんの = 'she doesn't have any, you see'.
